text: The system shall prevent unintended acceleration of the vehicle in all operating conditions.
title: Unintended Acceleration Prevention

text: The system shall detect and respond to loss of vehicle steering control within 50ms.
title: Steering Loss Detection

text: The Electronic Control Unit (ECU) shall monitor the accelerator pedal sensor voltage within the range 0.5V–4.5V at a minimum rate of 10ms.
title: Accelerator Pedal Sensor Monitoring

text: The ECU shall transition to a safe state (engine torque reduction to 0 Nm) within 20ms upon detection of a sensor out-of-range condition.
title: Safe State Transition on Sensor Fault

text: The steering angle sensor shall be read at minimum 5ms cycle time and validated against a redundant sensor with a deviation threshold of ±2°.
title: Steering Angle Sensor Redundancy

text: The software shall implement a first-order plausibility check on accelerator pedal sensor values comparing primary and secondary channels; a difference exceeding 0.2V shall raise DiagnosticEvent_APS_Mismatch.
title: Accelerator Pedal Sensor SW Plausibility

text: The software shall activate the torque-reduction safe state within two consecutive monitoring cycles (20ms) upon a latched DiagnosticEvent_APS_Mismatch.
title: Torque Reduction Trigger

text: The software shall log all diagnostic events to non-volatile memory with a timestamp accurate to ±1ms.
title: Diagnostic Event Logging

text: The system shall respond to any driver input within 50ms under normal operating conditions.
title: System Input Response Time

text: The system shall maintain CAN bus communication with a maximum latency of 5ms between ECU nodes.
title: CAN Bus Latency

text: The system shall support firmware updates via the OBD-II diagnostic interface without interrupting vehicle operation.
title: OTA Firmware Update

text: The system shall log all CAN bus errors exceeding a burst rate of 10 errors per second to persistent storage.
title: CAN Error Logging

text: The brake pressure sensor shall be sampled at a minimum rate of 20ms and validated for plausibility against vehicle speed data.
title: Brake Pressure Sensor Sampling
